brand.rule: Product colours appear in swatches and photographs only, never in the interface.

studio.note: 2048px transparent PNG, white studio, three-quarter front-left. Use as the geometry and colour reference for every generation.

sourceAssets.courseNote: Real photography, White / Red colourway only, parkland course, overcast-bright. Match this grade.

shotList.title: The fold, as a sequence
shotList.brief: Five frames, same camera, same light: unfolded → front wheel folding in → frame closing → locked cube → cube carried one-handed. Reference the studio PNG for geometry and colour.

shotList.title: The folded cube, hero
shotList.brief: The locked cube on a plain light ground, three-quarter, raking light from the top left, shot to show it is a cube. This is the one image the page most needs and does not have.

shotList.title: Boot shot
shotList.brief: The folded cube in the boot of an estate car with a bag beside it, daylight, no people.

shotList.title: Smart Organizer, top-down macro
shotList.brief: Directly above the console with a scorecard, pencil, three tees and a ball in place. Fills the frame.

shotList.title: Wheel off
shotList.brief: A hand pulling a rear wheel clear of the axle, mid-movement, shallow depth of field.

shotList.title: Footbrake
shotList.brief: A shoe pressing the brake pedal, low angle, grass.

shotList.title: Black / Lime and Black / White on the course
shotList.brief: The two colourways that have no lifestyle photography at all — only White / Red was shot. Same location and light as 014A2245.

shotList.title: Bag compatibility
shotList.brief: The same trolley with a stand bag and with a cart bag, identical framing, so the two can be crossfaded.

howToUse: Generate each shot, save to design-system/assets/generated/, add its filename to tools/three-generated.json keyed by shot slug, then run tools/build-three-page.py and publish with ~/.claude/bin/artifact.
